observations: Photo 0: Close-up of an engine valve cover embossed with 'DAF 24 VALVE'. Below it, a cast component reads 'DAF' and the number '11428068'. Surrounding parts include hoses, a fan, and wiring.
Photo 1: A pile of used engines and car parts outdoors. A large fan clutch sits in the foreground. Several engines are visible, partially covered by a dirty beige tarp.
Photo 2: A dirty diesel engine in the foreground with 'DAF' visible on the valve cover. Additional engines and mechanical parts are stacked in the background under tarps.
not_shown: Whether the engine runs or starts
